text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays, Trainer. Here's a present for you from Santa Claus. May it bring you plenty of joy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, though just for today. You see, I went to a holiday party recently where I spoke with Oguri…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So I hear your outfit was put together by some friends of yours. Sounds like something my fans would do. How wonderful…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes. Still, it's a shame that I'll only be wearing it today. If only I had more opportunities…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's easy. Why don't you be our next Santa?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And that's how I was chosen to play the part of Santa for the academy's holiday event.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now that I'm actually doing it, though, I feel a little worried. I'm not sure whether everyone will be happy to have me in the role.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: AH! I FOUND SANTA HAYAHIDEEE!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Figured you'd stand out dressed like that on campus.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed. But it does make for a perfect Santa. You've both done such a great job. Although if I did have any reservations…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide explains her concerns over whether she'll be able to make the event suitably fun.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: In that case, you could hype everyone up with impact! Like… Yeah! How about this? Hayahide, turn around!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I knew it! From behind, your hair looks just like Santa's bushy beard! What if you run around backwards while you hand out the presents?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: B-bushy beard?! My hair?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it makes you look just like Santa! We could call you "Backwards Santa"!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What, and run up to people in reverse like a horror movie? She'll scare them… She's the star of the day, so she should just hand out presents normally.
choice_data_list: Strive for impact and run around backwards!
Play the starring role and pass presents out normally.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Running… backwards? With a… bushy beard? Ngh… I suppose that would make an impact. All right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hoo! Haa! Happy holidaaaays!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wha?! Was that Santa just now… running backwards?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa! Taa! Happy holidaaays!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: WHOA! Who the heck is that suspicious figure running down the halls?! Don't tell me somebody's snuck into the academy?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O! You saw that manic Santa sprinting around backwards too?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I did! We have a suspicious intruder! This is super exciting, isn't it?! …Wait, no—it's not! It's a CAMPUS CRISIS!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Right! It's time for a hero to save the day! I'll show that creep who's boss! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Urk! Her eyes are positively gleaming! But I can't let her catch me!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (I must play the role! If people find out that Santa is actually me, their dreams will be crushed!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What?! Dang it! I lost 'em! Grrr. There goes my chance to perform some heroics!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant… Huff… (I got away! That was close, but I managed to fulfill my role as Santa Claus!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide continues passing the presents out, and before long a huge crowd of students has gathered around her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The "starring role," you say? That means I should approach the part with confidence, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays! Now then, who here would like a present?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Me! Me! Me! I wanna get a marvelous present! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! I want a present too! ♪ Gimme something for a grown-up, pleeease! ☆

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh, you're giving out presents?! Yay! Gimme all of 'em! I want everything in that sack!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What?! That's no fair! I want all of them too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, only one each, okay? And don't forget, if you're on the naughty list, you won't get anything.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm… So as long as we're good, we get a present?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That means… you might have one for me?! I'm pretty sure I'm on the nice list!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I wasn't expecting you to get this excited, hehe. But of course, I have a present for you right here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I wonder what it could be. I hope it's edible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide continues passing the presents out, and before long a huge crowd of students has gathered around her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, there are plenty more presents to go around. Just be patient, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sorry I'm late. I was preparing special gifts for the two of you. These ones come with letters.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ooh, what does mine say? "As I begin to transcribe my gratitude for you both, I find the reasons to thank you are never-ending. The first takes me back to the day we met…"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's so long. I'll read it when I get back to my dorm. Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course. I just hope that today ends up being a special day for you both. Happy holidays.
